_comment: F9bomber ledger identity table (scripts/import_f9_ledger.py). Keys are norm()-normalized F9 spellings (lowercase alphanumeric only); values are Steam64 strings that MUST exist in data/steamid_to_name.txt (the importer fails loudly otherwise). exclude_names drops a ledger row from the external-duel feed when ANY participant (commander or thug) normalizes into the set -- identities the operator declined to resolve (2026-09-13 sign-off). Overlap rows are still recorded for the adjudication jogger regardless of excluded names.
